files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path
format: one JSON file per entity, files[<entity>].path: {"cube", "entity", "columns", "rows", "windows"}; windows[<administration>] = {month_0, months, file_version (month 0 first)}
manifest_hash_method: sha256 of data/opm_manifest.json canonical content: records sorted by (dataset, filename), json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))

columns.name: entity
columns.description: 'DOJ' for the department total, else the component's agency_subelement_code (pipeline/crosswalks/components.csv); display names belong to the front end

columns.name: series_group
columns.description: job series group (D-062): a listed occupational_series_code, or 'other' for every other code including blank and NULL; pipeline/crosswalks/series_groups.csv

columns.name: administration
columns.description: administration id (D-065): obama2, trump1, biden, trump2; names in the meta

columns.name: months_in_office
columns.description: N: months in office, month 1 = January of the inauguration year (D-066)

columns.name: admin_months
columns.description: months of the administration's window that are published (up to the entity's last month, D-024)

columns.name: month_0
columns.description: the last month-end before month 1 (YYYY-MM)

columns.name: month_n
columns.description: calendar month of month N (YYYY-MM)

columns.name: time_basis
columns.description: 'effective': flows counted by personnel_action_effective_date_month (invariant 6)

columns.name: provisional
columns.description: months 1..N contain any of the newest 3 effective months (invariant 8)

columns.name: partial
columns.description: the administration is still in office (its window is open: Trump II)

columns.name: reissued
columns.description: month 0 or a month of 1..N changed file version since the previous manifest

columns.name: opm_incomplete
columns.description: a month of the period OPM marks incomplete for DOJ; currently none

columns.name: headcount_0
columns.description: headcount at month 0

columns.name: headcount_n
columns.description: headcount at the end of month N

columns.name: headcount_change
columns.description: headcount_n minus headcount_0 (D-066); the page shows the percent as headcount_change / headcount_0

columns.name: hires
columns.description: accession rows effective over months 1..N (running sum)

columns.name: departures
columns.description: separation rows effective over months 1..N (running sum) (all codes; transfers out and DRP included)

columns.name: sep_transfer_out
columns.description: departures with separation code SA + SB (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_quit
columns.description: departures with separation code SC (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_retirement
columns.description: departures with separation code SD + SE + SG (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_rif
columns.description: departures with separation code SH (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_termination
columns.description: departures with separation code SJ (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_other
columns.description: departures with separation code SL (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: sep_drp
columns.description: departures with drp_indicator = 'Y', any code; an overlay outside the partition

columns.name: sep_transfer_out_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SA + SB and drp_indicator not 'Y' (D-080): sep_transfer_out without DRP; sep_drp plus the _nondrp columns partition departures (the reasons charts)

columns.name: sep_quit_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SC and drp_indicator not 'Y' (D-080): sep_quit without DRP; sep_drp plus the _nondrp columns partition departures (the reasons charts)

columns.name: sep_retirement_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SD + SE + SG and drp_indicator not 'Y' (D-080): sep_retirement without DRP; sep_drp plus the _nondrp columns partition departures (the reasons charts)

columns.name: sep_rif_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SH and drp_indicator not 'Y' (D-080): sep_rif without DRP; sep_drp plus the _nondrp columns partition departures (the reasons charts)

columns.name: sep_termination_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SJ and drp_indicator not 'Y' (D-080): sep_termination without DRP; sep_drp plus the _nondrp columns partition departures (the reasons charts)

columns.name: sep_other_nondrp
columns.description: departures with separation code SL and drp_indicator not 'Y' (D-080): sep_other without DRP; sep_drp plus the _nondrp columns partition departures (the reasons charts)

columns.name: acc_transfer_in
columns.description: hires with accession code AA (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: acc_new_hire
columns.description: hires with accession code AC + AD + AE (D-015); part of the partition

columns.name: attrition_num
columns.description: all departures over months 1..N x 12 / N (D-066); rate = attrition_num / rate_den

columns.name: quit_num
columns.description: departures SC over months 1..N x 12 / N (D-066); rate = quit_num / rate_den

columns.name: retirement_num
columns.description: departures SD + SE + SG over months 1..N x 12 / N (D-066); rate = retirement_num / rate_den

columns.name: rate_den
columns.description: mean month-end headcount over months 1..N; null (never 0) when that mean is 0 (D-027)

columns.name: rate_months
columns.description: N, the months averaged into rate_den

columns.name: rate_small_base
columns.description: rate_den < 30 (invariant 9); null when the rate is empty

columns.name: acc_competitive
columns.description: new hires with accession code AC; acc_competitive, acc_excepted, acc_ses partition acc_new_hire (L-149)

columns.name: acc_excepted
columns.description: new hires with accession code AD; acc_competitive, acc_excepted, acc_ses partition acc_new_hire (L-149)

columns.name: acc_ses
columns.description: new hires with accession code AE; acc_competitive, acc_excepted, acc_ses partition acc_new_hire (L-149)

columns.name: hire_num
columns.description: all hires (new hires and transfers in; D-100) over months 1..N x 12 / N (D-066); rate = hire_num / rate_den
